notes.title: 🌍 LOCALIZATION UPDATE – CornField now speaks your language! 🗣️
notes.content:
[h1]🌍 LOCALIZATION UPDATE 🌍[/h1][h2]🎮 Early Access – Beta 1.0.85.1 🎮[/h2][p]We're thrilled to announce a major language expansion in [b]CornField[/b] ! 🛠️🌐

With this update, you can now play the game in [b]10 new languages[/b]:
[/p][list][*][p]🇬🇧 ✔️ English (existing)[/p][/*][*][p]🇨🇳 ✔️ Chinese (Simplified)[/p][/*][*][p]🇨🇿 ✔️ Czech[/p][/*][*][p]🇫🇷 ✔️ French[/p][/*][*][p]🇩🇪 ✔️ German[/p][/*][*][p]🇯🇵 ✔️ Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]🇧🇷 ✔️ Portuguese (Brazil)[/p][/*][*][p]🇷🇺 ✔️ Russian[/p][/*][*][p]🇪🇸 ✔️ Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]🇹🇷 ✔️ Turkish[/p][/*][*][p]🇺🇦 ✔️ Ukrainian[/p][/*][/list][p]We're entering a new global phase for the game – more players, more screams, more survival. 🧟‍♂️

[u]please note that some translations may be incomplete or contain minor issues – we are actively improving them.[/u]

Thank you for supporting CornFIeld! 🎁

– 🪐 Galactic Games Team
[/p]
